tasks.title: Implement the carrypatch recovery hook: reset fetch, compare and compare-and-swap move
steps: Write the listed tests with a real bare fork, real trunk and an injectable fetch stub; confirm they fail

Create internal/carrypatch/recovery.go: a RecoveryService constructed with the git runner factory, workspace root, variable getter (store.GetVariableValue), spec 20 origin credential resolver, an injectable single-branch fetch func (default: spec 21 fetch), job queue, spec 20 PatchStore methods and PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE parser; expose ReadReplacedSHA, RemoveBackup and RunReset
ReadReplacedSHA: runner rev-parse --verify --end-of-options refs/hub/replaced/<branch>^{commit}; absent ref -> not found; missing trunk dir -> not found without error
RemoveBackup: git update-ref -d refs/hub/replaced/<branch>; missing ref is success; missing trunk is success with slog.Info; other errors returned (shared helper also used by purge)

RunReset: wslock.TryLock(slug) only inside the hook (busy -> classified Busy error); fetch +refs/heads/<branch>:refs/remotes/origin/<branch> in both modes with credentials via the resolver (credential failure / fetch failure / missing branch classified, underlying text logged not returned); no ref writes on these failures

Resolve fork tip refs/remotes/origin/<branch>^{commit} and local tip refs/heads/<branch>^{commit}; apply first matching rule: missing local -> CAS create (action created); same SHA -> none; local strict ancestor of fork (GitRunner.IsAncestor on SHAs) -> fast_forwarded, no backup; else write backup with GitRunner.UpdateRef then move (action replaced)

Move through spec 20's compare-and-swap helper (update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old>, hard reset of worktree when branch is checked out); if it is not callable from carrypatch, extract and share it rather than duplicate; lost race -> RefChanged, other failure -> Other, keep backup already written, no further writes

Define carrypatch-local result and error types (no import of workspace); in cmd/af-hub/main.go add an adapter that converts them to the workspace ResetResult/ResetError types and calls workspace.RegisterRecoveryHook next to the existing hook registrations
Confirm go list -deps shows no import between internal/workspace and internal/carrypatch in either direction
